task_completion_rate.completion_summary: Identified phishing site (amazon-returns.co) linked from the email. Returned to Gmail. Do NOT submit personal info there. Recommended next steps: mark the message as phishing in Gmail, delete it, and—if you expect an Amazon refund—sign in directly at https://www.amazon.com (not via email links) to check order/return status and contact Amazon Customer Service.
